contracts: Local account activation validates credentials and shared Codex links before changing the active plan or stopping a running agent. Failed restore plans retain their original metadata and diagnostics.
Automatic switching requires a ready connected observer reporting idle or turn completed. Unknown state, reconciling state and output silence do not authorize interruption.
setup-token exec failures use a close-on-exec error channel and retain their actual cause; PTY descriptors and child status are collected.
